purpose: Teach: 責める/信憑/引き合い/駆け引き/特筆/計る/かねる/直近

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 失敗、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、責めることなく、絶対、改善、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When we fail, I don't want blame. I want solutions and forward movement. That's what I'm asking.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Sharp attack on the opening. Steady pace, no softening. Authority that doesn't shout. Light emphasis on 'solutions' — the point that matters. Slight weight on the closing phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。報告書、本気で、絶対、信憑性、絶対、徹底させております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're keeping our reports rigorous and credible. I appreciate your confidence in us.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Even delivery, no rushing. Quiet pride beneath the formality. The 'thank you' lands genuine, not performative. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 過去の事例、本気で、絶対、引き合いに、絶対、出して、絶対、説得しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Pull examples from what's worked before. Use them to convince. That's your next step.
lines.style: Instruction-sharp. Each phrase crisp, minimal. Tempo quickens slightly on 'worked before.' Stops abruptly at the end — no cushioning. A boss who trusts you'll understand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商談、本気で、絶対、駆け引きが、絶対、必要ですね、本気で、絶対、慎重に、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. These deals need strategy and careful handling. We're moving forward with that in mind.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Slower tempo on 'strategy and careful' — these matter. Voice settles lower, more thoughtful. The closing is assured without being overconfident. Attentive, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手の働き、本気で、絶対、特筆すべき、絶対、ものがあるな、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、評価していこう
lines.en: The younger staff — they're doing remarkable work. I'm noticing it. We should recognize that.
lines.style: Warmer than before. Opens with slight surprise in the inflection. Pace slows on 'remarkable work' — this is genuine observation, not flattery. The closing is quiet conviction, almost to himself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。生産量、本気で、絶対、毎月、絶対、計る習慣、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team is tracking output carefully every month, and it shows. I'm grateful for their effort.
lines.style: Composed, slightly proud. Steady rhythm that underscores reliability. Light emphasis on 'every month' — discipline matters. The gratitude is brief but warm, grounded in respect not sentiment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様の、本気で、絶対、ご要望、絶対、お断りしかねる、絶対、丁寧に、対応しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Our best clients matter most. Handle their requests with care and respect. Don't say no lightly.
lines.style: Firm and clear. Open with quiet intensity. Straightforward delivery, no hedging. Slight pause before 'don't say no lightly' — weight on that instruction. The tone is protective of the relationship.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。直近の業績、本気で、絶対、好調、絶対、社員、皆、頑張ってくれて、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our recent results speak for themselves. Everyone on the team pushed hard. We're thankful.
lines.style: Closing warmth. Calm satisfaction. Pace steady and grounded. Light emphasis on 'everyone' — inclusive recognition. The closing 'thankful' is genuinely warm, not obligatory. Slight exhale at the end.
